name: The Pine of Via del Pino
access: Free, stands on the public sidewalk of a residential street
transport: Duse D'Annunzio bus stop (Autolinee Toscane), about 2 minutes on foot
verify_notes: MASAF sheet 27/D612/FI/09: Pinus pinea L., girth 437 cm, height 29.0 m, comune Firenze, locality simply "Via del Pino" (the tree is the reason the street has that name). Second source: perunaltracitta.org (La Citta invisibile, 2024-06-03), an independent piece specifically about this tree, standing on the sidewalk squeezed between buildings and small shops, described as a witness/sentinel to the neighbourhood; it cites two published dendrology surveys that include it, Patriarchi vegetali: un patrimonio da salvare (Bellini & Guidi) and Toscana cento alberi da salvare (Capodarca). Third confirmation: RAMI (Il Registro degli Alberi) posted about this exact tree on its own page, confirming the street-naming fact independently. No age recorded anywhere found this pass; state as not documented rather than estimating from girth alone (stone pines vary hugely in growth rate with pruning/pollarding history and no comparable local growth-rate figure was found). Alive: the perunaltracitta piece is dated 2024 and describes the tree in the present tense, standing among the shops; no death/felling report found. Genuinely public: it stands on the pavement/sidewalk of an ordinary residential street, not behind any gate.
